Subtracting 359 days from 1243-01-19:  
1243 is not a leap year (1243 mod 4 = 3).  
359 days before Jan 19, 1243 = 1242-???.  
Days back: Jan 19 → 18 days into 1243.  
359 − 18 = 341 days into 1242.  
1242 is a leap year (1242 mod 4 = 2 → yes, leap in Julian calendar).  
Jan 31, Feb 29, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31, Nov 30, Dec 31.  
Sum months: Jan 31 (31), Feb 29 (60), Mar 31 (91), Apr 30 (121), May 31 (152), Jun 30 (182), Jul 31 (213), Aug 31 (244), Sep 30 (274), Oct 31 (305), Nov 30 (335).  
341 − 335 = 6 days into December → Dec 6, 1242.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1242-12-06
